acceptance_criteria.description: The compiled execution contains a secret-free ProviderBinding with provider and model identity plus credential name and value digest only.
A native content-bound ModelActivationReceipt proves the effective provider and model match the requested openai/gpt-5.6 tuple.
Input, output, cache and monetary usage are retained when natively observed; unavailable values remain null rather than zero.
Focused tests, manifest compilation and standalone evidence checks for the activation and usage path pass.

objective: Complete the secret-free provider binding and native runtime evidence path for the requested openai/gpt-5.6 Magenta execution, including effective provider/model activation and observable token and cost usage without coercing unknown values to zero.
title: Bind Magenta provider activation and usage evidence
